title: Constant variable index
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits and $m$ gates, index the variables by the disjoint union of one constant variable and $n+m$ further variables. The constant variable has index $0$ in this ordering.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with a finite number of input bits and gates
